primary_outcome: final feasible_nonroot_loss after the last update within the fixed budget
analysis: Within each family, use the 20 paired graph seeds. Report all seed-level differences, their mean and a 95% confidence interval. Control the two primary family comparisons with Holm correction. No best-checkpoint selection, seed dropping, or method retuning based on these outcomes.
validation: Each cell must have a source-pinned receipt, matching system hash across four arms, exact 2000 environment samples, finite final metrics, and no candidate-probe samples. Failed cells are repaired and rerun before reading family aggregate results.
scope: Known fully observed DAGs; numerical SCM inference only; no closed-source model calls. The 20 seeds are independent within each 30-node family, but family generators are synthetic and do not establish external transfer.
